next.reason: §2023:14.9.49.4 GR7 b) 'If the I-O status value does not indicate a fatal EC-I-O exception condition, control is returned to an implicit CONTINUE statement following the input-output statement' (1985 'returns control to the next executable statement following the input-output statement'); GR7 c) 'the implementor determines what action is taken' (1985 the same for a critical error). 1985 critical = 3x, 4x and implementor 9x; §2023:9.1.13.1 makes 3x, 4x, 7x and implementor 9x fatal, and 7x arises only from 2023-only line sequential and record content rules. GR7 a) only defers to SORT/MERGE. §2023:14.9.49.4 GR12 restates this for format 3 (EC-I-O exception-names) and does not govern this format-1 rule, so it is not listed.
